source.name: Multistate maize yield trials (Shrestha et al. 2024)
source.detail: Public research dataset used for practice until the challenge data is released: 84 hybrids at five US Corn Belt sites in 2022, six Pléiades Neo satellite images per plot, harvested plot yields. CC0.

citation: Shrestha N., Powadi A., Davis J., et al. (2024). Crop performance, aerial, and satellite data from multistate maize yield trials. Dryad/Zenodo, doi:10.5061/dryad.905qftttm. CC0 1.0.
